# B2B Lead Growth

> B2B Lead Growth is a founder-run B2B lead-generation and outreach service for service
> businesses, currently focused first on residential HVAC and other home-service
> contractors in New Jersey (serving the United States). It is a monthly service, not a
> lead seller: it does not sell or resell leads, shared or exclusive. Pricing is
> published: $750 (researched prospect list, client sends), $1,500 (personalised outreach
> and follow-up run for the client), or $2,500 (adds reply qualification and booking
> qualified calls on the client's calendar) per month, month-to-month, no setup fee,
> 14 days' notice to cancel either side. The entry offer is a Free Pipeline Audit — a
> sharpened ideal-customer profile plus 3–5 individually vetted, cited prospects and one
> sample outreach message, free, that the prospect keeps regardless of whether they
> become a client. The company started in 2026 and says so plainly: it has no clients,
> testimonials, case studies, or results to publish yet and publishes none, and it never
> guarantees lead counts, replies, meetings, or revenue.

- [Shared vs. Exclusive HVAC Leads](https://b2b-lead-growth-site.vercel.app/shared-vs-exclusive-hvac-leads): neutral cost-per-job math, with sources
- [How to Choose a Lead Generation Agency](https://b2b-lead-growth-site.vercel.app/how-to-choose-a-lead-generation-agency): red flags, questions to ask, and our own answers
- [Terms of Service](https://b2b-lead-growth-site.vercel.app/terms): what is sold, fees and billing, cancellation, refunds, termination, liability
- [Privacy Policy](https://b2b-lead-growth-site.vercel.app/privacy): what data is collected, how it is used, retention, and your rights
